## Free calculators

- [Free CAC Calculator — What Can You Actually Pay for a Customer?](https://mediapuppies.com/cac-calculator/): Free customer acquisition cost calculator for Indian D2C and lead-gen businesses. Work out your CAC ceiling from your own margins
- [A/B test sample size calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ab-test-sample-size-calculator/): Work out how many visitors each variant needs and how long the test will take at your traffic level, before you start running it.
- [A/B test significance calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ab-test-significance-calculator/): Check whether the difference between two ad or landing page variants is real or noise. Two-proportion z-test with p-value and confidence level.
- [Ad copy length checker](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ad-copy-length-checker/): Check ad text against Meta and Google character limits, including the point where Meta hides the rest behind “See more”.
- [Reach and frequency calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ad-frequency-calculator/): Work out how many people your budget reaches, how often each of them sees the ad, and whether that is too little to register or enough to annoy.
- [Agency vs in-house cost calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/agency-vs-inhouse-calculator/): The real annual cost of hiring a media buyer versus paying an agency retainer, including the costs people forget: tools, recruitment, cover and downtime.
- [Blended ROAS and MER calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/blended-roas-calculator/): Compare what the ad platforms claim against what your bank account shows. Works out blended efficiency and how much is being double-counted.
- [Break-even ROAS calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator/): Work out the return on ad spend you need to break even and to hit a target margin. Accounts for cost of goods, shipping, returns and fees.
- [Budget pacing calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/budget-pacing-calculator/): Are you on track to spend the month’s budget? Work out your required daily spend from here, and what over- or under-pacing is costing you.
- [CAC payback period calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/cac-payback-calculator/): How many months it takes to earn back what you paid to acquire a customer, and what that means for how hard you can push acquisition spend.
- [Churn and retention calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/churn-retention-calculator/): Turn a monthly churn rate into average customer lifetime, annual retention and the revenue you lose every year without noticing.
- [COD vs prepaid profit calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/cod-vs-prepaid-calculator/): What cash on delivery actually costs once RTO, two-way shipping and COD fees are counted — and what a prepaid discount is worth.
- [Contribution margin calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/contribution-margin-calculator/): What one order actually contributes after cost of goods, shipping, payment fees and returns — and therefore the most you can pay to acquire a customer.
- [Creative volume calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/creative-volume-calculator/): How many new ad concepts a month your spend level actually needs, based on how fast creative fatigues at your audience size and frequency.
- [GST on ad spend calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/gst-on-ads-calculator/): What 18% GST does to your real marketing cost, including reverse charge on Meta and Google invoices and what changes if you are not registered.
- [Influencer rate calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/influencer-rate-calculator/): Check whether an influencer’s quote is reasonable: cost per engaged follower, cost per thousand reached, and what you would need to sell to break even.
- [Lakh and crore converter](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/lakh-crore-converter/): Convert between plain numbers and lakh or crore, with Indian digit grouping and the international equivalent. Works both ways.
- [Lead funnel calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/lead-funnel-calculator/): Start from the number of customers you want and work backwards to the leads, clicks and ad budget you need. Shows where the funnel leaks.
- [Meta learning phase calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/learning-phase-calculator/): Work out the budget an ad set needs to reach roughly 50 conversions a week and leave the learning phase, and what happens if you split the budget instead.
- [Customer lifetime value calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ltv-calculator/): Work out customer lifetime value on gross profit, compare it against what you pay to acquire a customer, and see your LTV to CAC ratio.
- [Marketplace payout calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/marketplace-payout-calculator/): Work out what actually reaches your bank from a marketplace order after commission, closing, shipping and returns — using your own category rates.
- [Media math calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/media-math-calculator/): Enter spend, impressions, clicks and conversions and get CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA and conversion rate at once. Free, no signup.
- [Meta ads budget calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/meta-ads-budget-calculator/): Work out the monthly and daily Meta ads budget you need for a target number of leads, and whether that budget is enough to exit the learning phase.
- [PPC forecast calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ppc-forecast-calculator/): Turn an ad budget into clicks, leads and customers using your own cost per click and conversion rates, and see what the result is worth.
- [ROAS calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/roas-calculator/): Free ROAS calculator: enter ad spend and revenue to get return on ad spend, then add your margin to see break-even ROAS and profit after ads.
- [SERP snippet preview](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/serp-snippet-preview/): See how your title tag and meta description will look in Google, measured in pixels rather than characters, with a live truncation preview.
- [Time zone overlap calculator](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/timezone-overlap-calculator/): How many hours your working day shares with a team or client in another country, and what shift pattern fixes it when the answer is none.
- [UTM campaign URL builder](https://mediapuppies.com/tools/utm-builder/): Build tagged campaign URLs for Google Analytics and any other tool. Lowercases and encodes automatically so your reports do not split.
